overview: WebSailor-V2 introduces a complete post-training pipeline for open-source web agents, featuring dense cyclic knowledge graph data synthesis with diverse uncertainties (SailorFog-QA-V2) and a symbiotic dual-environment reinforcement learning framework (Sim-to-Real) to stabilize policy learning and bridge the performance gap with proprietary systems.

modules.name: Knowledge Graph Constructor
modules.description: Constructs a densely interconnected knowledge graph from seed entities using web tools, intentionally creating cyclic structures and storing procedural information and statistical features to overcome the limitations of linear or tree-like data expansion.

modules.name: Subgraph Extractor
modules.description: Extracts structurally distinct subgraphs from the dense knowledge graph using a random-walk based approach, verifying non-isomorphism via the Weisfeiler-Leman algorithm to ensure topological diversity.

modules.name: Uncertainty Injector
modules.description: Introduces diverse uncertainties into the subgraph data beyond simple obfuscation, specifically implementing Semantic Ambiguity (under-specifying entities), Distractor Noise (injecting plausible but incorrect facts), and Structural Constraints (identifying and targeting cut vertices).

modules.name: QA Generator
modules.description: Generates instruction-tuning pairs (SailorFog-QA-V2) by analyzing non-isomorphic nodes in the extracted subgraphs, evenly distributing the QA focus across all orbit nodes while incorporating the injected uncertainties.

modules.name: Simulated Environment Builder
modules.description: Builds a high-fidelity simulated web environment based on an offline Wikipedia corpus, providing a deterministic, high-frequency, and cost-efficient platform with simulated search and visit tools for algorithmic experimentation (the 'Wind Tunnel').

modules.name: ReAct Agent Core
modules.description: Implements the foundational ReAct agentic framework, managing the iterative loop of Thought, Action, and Observation, and sampling actions from the policy conditioned on the preceding context.

modules.name: Unified Tool Execution Interface
modules.description: Architects a robust interface for the real-world environment that schedules and manages diverse tools (Search, Visit, Scholar, Python), incorporating QPS constraints, caching, timeout-and-retry protocols, and fault tolerance to insulate the agent from real-world API volatility.

modules.name: Dual-Environment Router
modules.description: Manages the switching logic between the simulated and real environments, enabling staged training where high-frequency tuning occurs in simulation before policy transfer to the managed real-world interface.

modules.name: SFT Cold Start Pipeline
modules.description: Executes the Supervised Fine-Tuning phase using rejection-sampled trajectories from high-performing open-source models on the SailorFog-QA-V2 dataset, establishing a robust initial policy for RL exploration.

modules.name: RL Rollout Engine
modules.description: Manages the generation of trajectories in both simulated and real environments using the current policy, supporting asynchronous rollouts and interaction with the reward service.

modules.name: Reward Service
modules.description: Calculates outcome-based rewards for trajectories, distinguishing between correct answers, format errors, invalid tool calls, and length limit exceedances to provide precise learning signals.

modules.name: Custom GRPO Algorithm
modules.description: Implements the tailored Group Relative Policy Optimization algorithm with token-level policy gradient loss, importance sampling ratio clipping, and leave-one-out advantage estimation to reduce variance.

modules.name: Negative Sample Handler
modules.description: Implements the conservative strategy for negative trajectories by masking the loss for trajectories that exceed length limits without final answers, while assigning explicit negative rewards for format or tool-call errors to prevent format collapse.

modules.name: Dynamic Data Curation Loop
modules.description: Implements the symbiotic feedback loop between data generation and model training, automatically synthesizing and filtering high-quality training data based on real-time training dynamics to optimize the information stream.

modules.name: Benchmark Evaluator
modules.description: Runs the trained agent on evaluation benchmarks (BrowseComp, GAIA, xbench-DeepSearch, HLE) under strict constraints of context length and tool call budgets, supporting both simulated and real-world testing.

modules.name: Metric & Training Dynamics Analyzer
modules.description: Calculates Pass@k metrics and uses LLM-as-a-Judge for accuracy evaluation, while also tracking and visualizing training dynamics such as reward curves, policy entropy, and performance oscillation across environments.
